title: Apartment Home Lease Leasing Fee Schedule
content:
Three one-time leasing charges on the Apartment Home Lease are fixed per floor plan: the screening fee charged per adult applicant when an application is submitted, the lease administration fee charged when an application is approved, and the charge for adding or removing a leaseholder or occupant during the term.

| Floor plan | Screening fee per adult applicant | Lease administration fee | Lease modification fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | $55.00 | $250.00 | $150.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | $55.00 | $250.00 | $150.00 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | $55.00 | $300.00 | $150.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | $55.00 | $300.00 | $150.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | $55.00 | $350.00 | $150.00 |
| Penthouse Residence | $55.00 | $500.00 | $150.00 |

**Screening fee per adult applicant** — the non-refundable screening fee charged for each adult applicant at application.
**Lease administration fee** — the one-time lease administration fee charged when the application is approved.
**Lease modification fee** — the charge for adding or removing a leaseholder or occupant mid-term.

### Notes on the schedule

- The screening fee is the same $55.00 on every floor plan; the administration fee rises with the floor plan, from $250.00 on the Studio and One-Bedroom Residences to $500.00 on the Penthouse Residence.
- The modification fee is $150.00 on every floor plan.

*Hypothetical example:* an application for a Three-Bedroom Residence screened with three adult applicants carries a screening fee of three times $55.00, that is $165.00, and approval of that application carries an administration fee of $350.00. The number of applicants is an example input.
